newsitem.title: UK: April ex-Soviet oil exports dip to 2.73 mbpd - IEA.
newsitem.headline: April ex-Soviet oil exports dip to 2.73 mbpd - IEA.

text.p: Exports of crude and refined products from the territories of the former Soviet Union dipped 10,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 2.73 million bpd in April, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Friday.

"Black Sea exports and Druzhba pipeline exports decreased by a combined 90,000 bpd but the decline was offset by higher Baltic exports and lower imports," the Paris-based agency said in its latest monthly oil market report.
March exports were revised down to 2.74 million bpd from 2.78 million bpd in the previous report.
The IEA said preliminary April estimates showed total seaborne crude exports were broadly unchanged but were "about 100,000 bpd lower than the same month a year earlier."
By contrast, seaborne product exports fell by 45,000 bpd but were still 30,000 bpd higher than the same month last year.
Pipeline exports to central and eastern Europe fell 50,000 bpd to 850,000 bpd.
Net product exports at 630,000 bpd were down 10,000 bpd in April.
Crude exports were unchanged at 2.10 million bpd.
